subject: Class 720 Aventra, Greater Anglia and c2c, 2025-26
method: Body from the GA 720/5 diagram (the 345's template, two-door layout) at the published 24.2 m, nose the 345's, face measured on 720524; every number's source in `trace`.

calibration.notes: dia GA-Class-720 (720/5): the 345's car-length template (car 1 0-764 px, car 2 778-1502) with the 720's two-door layout; lengths taken as published 24.2 m for both cars (31.6 and 29.9 px/m: the template is not to scale); vertical 33.2 px/m from row 185.5 as the 345's

trace.calibration: dia GA-Class-720 (720/5): the 345's car-length template (car 1 0-764 px, car 2 778-1502) with the 720's two-door layout; lengths taken as published 24.2 m for both cars (31.6 and 29.9 px/m: the template is not to scale); vertical 33.2 px/m from row 185.5 as the 345's
trace.heights: the 345's (same body, diagram template); window glass col 150 rows 88-120 -> 1.97-2.94 m
trace.cab.doors: dia row 100: cab door 62-87 px; doors 193-250, 554-611 (red #991425)
trace.nose: the 345's: the 720 diagram's nose outline is the same pixel for pixel
trace.face: 720524 near head-on (Colchester, 1280 px), scaled across by the body's half-width at the pods (195 px for 1.386 m: 141 px/m) from the grille's centre, up from the pods' centre at 1.655 m (the family's): the yellow panel +-1.06 m, 1.26-2.27 m, the pods set in its outer ends (0.65-1.04 m out, 1.35-1.97), grille +-0.37, 1.31-1.75, wiper housing 1.83-2.23; the black frame round the screen +-0.92 m down to the yellow's top, the glass +-0.80 at its foot (2.39 m) to +-0.88; the accent stripe (red on LE, magenta on c2c) on the cheek outboard of the frame from the roof cap down to the yellow; white bumper below with the coupler's recess +-0.75 m up to 1.13 m; number on the yellow at the left
trace.livery: dia col 150: dark roof cap to 3.32, black window band 1.88-3.0 m (rows 85-120 with the windows), light body, red line row 133 (1.58 m), dark grey lower band 1.13-1.55 (rows 134-148) on LE; its front edge rises back to 5.13 m at 1.55 m (row 130); the accent sweep a thin line from 0.63 m at 1.37 m to 5.86 m at 1.82 m (dia); review of the sheets (720573, 720606): the windows are plain glass in the white, not in a continuous black band (the band covered the doors' tops: removed); the cheek accent is a broad band about 0.22 m across the corner from the roof to the yellow; the thin slanting accent along the side is Greater Anglia's only
trace.livery.branding: Greater Anglia (LE key only; c2c's 720s carry no large mark on the cab car's side): LE ('greateranglia', its own red and grey) under the first window behind the cab door, on 720573 (Marks Tey) read along by a projective fit through the cab door's edges and the first window's (1.96/2.76/4.09/5.61 m; residuals to 15 cm: the template's window is not quite where the photo has it), up from the window's foot (1.97 m, 420 px/m): 3.62-4.83 m, 1.66-1.88 m with the descenders; 0.18 m tall at the artwork's 7.9 aspect
trace.livery.brandingCC: c2c (the c2c logo, in the magenta) on the white under the windows behind door 1: 720606 (Shoeburyness-bound, three-quarter) puts it about a third of the way from door 1's rear edge (7.92 m) to door 2's front (17.55 m) on the photo, foreshortened; taken 10.6 m without a camera fit (approximate, +-0.5 m); 0.2 m tall against the 0.51 m white band, centred 1.63 m
